name: Hotel Golf Alpin
beschreibung: Hotel Golf Alpin is set in the scenic mountain setting of the Kitzbühel region, surrounded by alpine forests and peaks. The hotel offers a serene ambiance dedicated to leisure and recreation. Guests benefit from proximity to an alpine golf course, numerous scenic hiking trails in summer, and major ski domains in winter. Amenities include a soothing wellness area with sauna and steam bath, alongside a restaurant serving fine regional fare.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Golf Alpin in the Kitzbühel region features peaceful alpine rooms, a sauna and steam wellness area, golf access, and proximity to world-class ski slopes.
